escalate.definition: To take a matter to a more senior person because it has not moved.
escalate.example: If we do not hear back by Friday, we will need to escalate this.

gre_emotional_labour.definition: The work of managing your own feelings and other people's feelings so that the situation keeps running.
gre_emotional_labour.example: Emotional labour is the invisible work of keeping a meeting calm.

pd_reciprocity.definition: The pressure to return a favour that the other side has given you.
pd_reciprocity.example: The discount was the favour, and the renewal at the same price was the bill.
